seo.title: Contact
seo.description: Contact Enyo-ojo Excel Meyanga about technical projects, design, digital visibility, collaboration or opportunities.

intro.label: Contact
heading: Tell me what
you have in mind.
intro.description: A technical challenge, a design brief, or an opportunity to work together. Share a little context and we can start the conversation.

topics.label: What would you like to discuss?
topics.heading: A little context goes a long way.
topics.description: Choose a topic to open an editable email template. Replace the bracketed details with your own before sending.

items.title: Engineering & AI
items.description: Share the problem, your current setup, and what a useful solution would look like.
items.subject: Technical project enquiry
items.template:
Hi Enyo-ojo,

My name is [your name]. I’m reaching out about [project or technical problem].

I need help with [describe the problem]. My current setup is [tools or system], and I have already tried [what you have tried].

The outcome I’m aiming for is [desired result]. My timeline is [timeline, if known].

Would you be open to discussing this?

Best,
[your name]
[company or organisation, optional]

items.title: Design & business visibility
items.description: Introduce your business or project, the audience you want to reach, and the support you need.
items.subject: Design or business visibility enquiry
items.template:
Hi Enyo-ojo,

My name is [your name]. I’m working on [business or project] and looking for design or visibility support.

I need help with [specific needs]. The audience I want to reach is [audience], and my current online presence is [website or profile links, if any].

My goal is [desired outcome]. My timeline is [timeline, if known].

Could we discuss what support would be appropriate?

Best,
[your name]
[company or organisation, optional]

items.title: Work & collaboration
items.description: Tell me what you are building, where I could contribute, and the scope you have in mind.
items.subject: Work or collaboration enquiry
prompts: Where you would like me to contribute:
items.template:
Hi Enyo-ojo,

My name is [your name]. I’d like to discuss a possible collaboration on [project].

We’re building [brief description], and I think you could contribute through [specific role or task].

The scope would be [expected responsibilities], with a timeline of [timeline, if known]. More context: [relevant link, optional].

Would you be interested in discussing it?

Best,
[your name]
[company or organisation, optional]

items.title: Opportunities & referrals
items.description: Share the opportunity, why you think it is a fit, and any relevant links or next steps.
items.subject: Opportunity or referral
prompts: Why it might be a fit:
items.template:
Hi Enyo-ojo,

My name is [your name]. I’d like to share [opportunity or referral].

It involves [brief description]. I thought of you because [why it might be a fit].

The details are [requirements or context], and the next step would be [next step or deadline, if any]. More information: [link, optional].

Let me know if you’d like to discuss it.

Best,
[your name]
[company or organisation, optional]
